item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Require valid source links before saving definitions","mechanism":"A required reference to an existing supplied passage prevents definitions from becoming detached from their evidence.","implementation":"Store passage IDs in a supplied-source registry. Require each definition variant to reference an existing ID; prohibit deleting referenced passages.","check":"Attempt saves with missing, unknown, and valid IDs. Only the valid case succeeds, and its source link opens the referenced passage.","risk":"A valid reference does not establish that wording is supported."},{"action":"Display competing wording beside its source","mechanism":"Separate variants preserve disagreement without forcing disputed definitions into a single editorial formulation.","implementation":"Give each variant its own wording, passage ID, and stable ID. Add a comparison view showing variants, source passages, and recorded objections.","check":"Enter two conflicting definitions. Verify readers can inspect both wordings, each source, and the objection without accessing editor-only controls.","risk":"An editorial preference could visually overshadow alternatives; label preference explicitly."},{"action":"Review source changes without silently replacing evidence","mechanism":"Versioned passages retain original support while dependency checks identify definitions needing review after a source edit.","implementation":"Assign changed passages new IDs and link their predecessors. Flag dependent variants for review; retain their original wording and references until explicitly revised.","check":"Edit a passage supporting two variants. Both receive review flags; their original passages remain inspectable, and neither reference changes automatically.","risk":"Review flags may accumulate; they must not hide existing definitions."},{"action":"Make competing wording searchable and directly shareable","mechanism":"Indexing every variant lets readers discover disagreements even when their search uses wording absent from the preferred definition.","implementation":"Index all variant text and passage IDs locally. Return term-grouped results with matched wording, dispute indicators, and stable links to individual variants.","check":"Search a phrase unique to a nonpreferred variant. Its result appears, and its direct link exposes that wording, source, and competing definition.","risk":"Grouping must not conceal which variant actually matched the query."}],"abstention_reason":""}
